note: DRIBL match centre API, 2026 season: Football SA (fsa.dribl.com) SL1 + SL2 + NPL (men's) all grades, and SAASL (saasl.dribl.com) Home and Away all grades. Extracted with extract_browser.js.
DRIBL does not record positions or formations for these leagues (1 player of ~530 sampled). Only GK vs outfield is known.
Starters: sub-off minute (or red card) else match length. Subs: match length minus sub-on minute. Bench unused: 0.

U18 leagues rarely record sub minutes. When missing, we assume a sub came on at 70', and a starter on a side with no recorded subs played the full match. Flagged in minutes_estimated / minutes_est_apps.
From the lineup goals list. Own goals excluded from 'goals'; penalties split out. Non-pen goals per 90 = goals_open_play / minutes * 90.

Reconstructed from the match-centre goal timeline. equaliser = level after; go_ahead = takes lead; winner = go-ahead goal after which the team never fell level, in a match it won; late = 75'+. About 28% of SAASL matches have no goal timeline at all (lineup goal totals are still recorded) — game-state and the Events sheet undercount there; Football SA (SL1/SL2/NPL) timelines are essentially complete.
Goals for/against while the player was on (using the minute window). gd_on_pitch_vs_team subtracts the team's regular-season GD per match.
Per-match 3-2-1 votes from DRIBL, likely best-on-ground — not shown publicly elsewhere. Recorded for about 249 of 294 matches.
DRIBL's flag for a player borrowed from another team in the club that match — a direct playing up/down signal.
Senior, reserves and U18 minutes summed across all the player's teams. A hidden gem is a non-senior row with zero senior minutes all season.

Eligible: 450+ minutes and 5+ apps. Rates are shrunk toward the league mean, as if starting from 450 minutes / 5 apps, so short bursts don't top the list — then compared as z-scores within league. Outfield weights: non-penalty goals/90 35%, votes/app 25%, on-pitch goal difference 20%, share of team goals 10%, share of team minutes 10%. Goalkeeper weights: goals conceded/90 (inverted) 25%, goals conceded vs team rate (inverted) 15%, clean sheet rate 30%, votes/app 20%, share of team minutes 10%. Hidden gems get +0.3, U18 players +0.15.
Regular-season ladders only. opp_top_half = opponent finished in the top half of its league.
Regular season only, only when the player started >= 3 and missed >= 3. Small samples: treat as a flag, not evidence.
date_local is Australia/Adelaide. Raw API dates are UTC.
U21 player in Senior NPL with a Sofascore rating >= 7.0 or xG+xA per 90 >= 0.40.
Player on a bottom-half team (min 450 minutes) with a duel win rate >= 60% or pass accuracy >= 80%.
